post.description: Single-use rotation: returns a new pair; the presented refresh token is revoked.

OAuth2 password flow (form-encoded `username`, `password`), so Swagger UI's
Authorize button works. Same 401 for unknown user, wrong password, disabled account.

get.description: Liveness probe: confirms the process is up. Does not check dependencies.

post.description:
Redact, extract (LLM + rules), ground, route and persist one note.

Synchronous: the request waits for the LLM (~6 s on the dev laptop). A job queue is
future work. If the LLM is down the note is still saved, with baseline flags.

get.description:
Notes needing a human decision: highest pending severity first, then oldest first.

Sorted in Python over all notes needing review: fine at prototype volumes; at scale,
store a priority column and sort and page in SQL.

post.description:
Plan one day: OR-Tools VRPTW (+ two-phase continuity if the weight is > 0), with
reasons for every assignment and every unassigned visit. Synchronous (10-60 s).

get.description: Carers ranked by risk (highest first), each with its three largest factors.

Every factor's contribution (log-odds; they add up to the score), with support
actions for the provider-side factors that raise risk.
